sum: Strive, Inc. provides investment advisory and structured finance services. The company operates through three segments: Asset Management, Medical Device, and Corporate and Other. The Asset Management segment provides investment advisory services and acts as sub-advisor to a series of exchange-traded funds, with products offered through exchange-traded funds and separate accounts. The Medical Device segment sells medical devices, generating revenue from software licensing, fee-per-test arrangements, and hardware sales. The Corporate and Other segment maintains a Bitcoin treasury strategy, acquiring and holding Bitcoin as a primary reserve asset, and issues preferred equity securities, including SATA and SATS. The company also operates an at-the-market equity program for continuous issuance of Class A common stock and SATA preferred stock. Strive, Inc. was formerly known as Asset Entities Inc. and changed its name to Strive, Inc. in September 2025. Strive, Inc. was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Dallas, Texas.
ceo: Mr. Matthew Ryan Cole C.F.A. (Chairman & CEO)
